verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a Slack channel monitor automation that opens a conversation from an @openhands mention and replies when the agent finishes. That is a first-party completion notification, but only within that Slack-triggered workflow. No general notification mechanism for task completion or for the agent needing input is evidenced. Missing for 10: notifications when the agent needs input or approval, a general completion notification across CLI/GUI/cloud sessions, configurable notification channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get notified when an agent completes a task or needs my input

citations.quote: Watch Slack channels for @openhands mentions, open a conversation with the message context, and reply when the agent finishes.
